description: Find a site's sitemaps (robots.txt Sitemap: lines, /sitemap.xml, sitemap indexes, .gz, .txt) and return every page URL with lastmod, changefreq and priority, up to 50,000. Filter by a word in the URL. For SEO audits, crawling plans and content monitoring. Live fetch, ~1-5 s. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.005/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/sitemap-extractor.
